item.title: [6.3] Leveraging Visual and Geometric Priors for Metric-scale and Complete Vehicle Gaussian Reconstruction from Limited Views
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

High-fidelity vehicle assets are essential for controllable traffic scene generation, particularly for synthesizing rare and safety-critical long-tail scenarios. However, reconstructing a reusable vehicle representation from in-the-wild onboard images remains challenging for two reasons. First, image-to-3D generation methods generally produce models without reliable metric scale.

WHY IT MATTERS

This research addresses a practical limitation in 3D vehicle asset reconstruction from sparse onboard views by combining visual priors and symmetry, which is useful for autonomous driving simulation pipelines.
